scope: Cathy personal 16:9 interview; latest user/project-approved overrides take precedence

playback.existing_approved_speed: preserve unless explicitly asked to retime this video

music.teaser_body_relationship: same track excerpts preferred, compatible different tracks allowed

initial_music_below_dialogue_db.measurement: RMS of separate stems over the same voiced interval
initial_music_below_dialogue_db.interpretation: starting ranges, not fader settings or acceptance thresholds

music.timeline: final output timeline; do not apply interview speed to music

long_screenshot.width_priority: at least approved comparable source width in this episode
long_screenshot.layout: readable width first, overflow clipped in fixed viewport
long_screenshot.native_metadata_visibility: sequential during scroll, not necessarily every frame

materials.classification: content-based; scrolling or zooming a still image remains static even if encoded as video

video.scope: Cathy supplied or designated video B-roll; explicit project overrides take precedence
video.source_audio: discard all source audio unless explicitly requested
video.duration_selection: complete action, interaction or scene; 15 seconds is a ceiling, not a target

provenance.watermark_background: Photon background depth only; Scott approved font and size retained
provenance.new_defaults: New Cathy projects: 1.2x teaser/body, fixed single-line captions and watermark, quiet instrumental music, scrolling static fullscreen sources up to4 seconds, supplied/designated dynamic B-roll up to15 seconds at independent source rate; mix and motion ranges are adjustable starting points
provenance.implementation_scope: Music and material motion are planning defaults; render_cathy_overlays.py generates static overlays only
